title: Suffices to the bracketed conditioning for the conditional mutual information step of sum_of_rdist_eq
intent: Prove the conditional mutual information step of the fibring identity by restating it with the conditioning rewritten from the expanded `Y 0 - Y 1 - Y 2 + Y 3` to the bracketed difference `Y 0 - Y 1 - (Y 2 - Y 3)`, so that the injective-map lemma `condMutualInfo_of_inj_map` matches; the residual difference between the two forms is discharged by `convert this using 2; abel`.
also_known_as: reformulate the goal to match a rewrite
bracket a subterm to expose a difference

parent.name: sum_of_rdist_eq_step_condMutualInfo
parent.statement:
lemma sum_of_rdist_eq_step_condMutualInfo {Y : Fin 4 → Ω → G}
    (h_meas : ∀ i, Measurable (Y i)) :
    I[⟨Y 0 - Y 1, Y 2 - Y 3⟩:⟨Y 0 - Y 2, Y 1 - Y 3⟩|Y 0 - Y 1 - (Y 2 - Y 3);μ] =
    I[Y 0 - Y 1 : Y 1 - Y 3|Y 0 - Y 1 - Y 2 + Y 3;μ]

children.name: suffices goal (conditioning bracketed)
children.closed_by: symm (line 126); rw [← condMutualInfo_of_inj_map hmij hmij hm0123 (fun z x ↦ (x, x - z)), condMutualInfo_comm hmf hmij, ← condMutualInfo_of_inj_map hmij hmf hm0123 (fun z x ↦ (x + z, x)), condMutualInfo_comm hmg hmf] (lines 136-139); then congr! 3 with ω with the two pointwise subgoals closed by simp and rw [sub_sub, add_sub_left_comm, ← sub_sub]; simp (lines 140-143); the two injectivity obligations closed by exact fun _ _ _ h ↦ (Prod.ext_iff.1 h).2 and exact fun _ _ _ h ↦ (Prod.ext_iff.1 h).1 (lines 144-145)

applicability.goal_shape: An equality of two conditional mutual informations I[X : Y | Z; μ] = I[X' : Y' | Z'; μ] whose proof is an injective-map rewrite (`condMutualInfo_of_inj_map`, `condMutualInfo_comm`) that only matches when the conditioning variable Z is syntactically a single difference (x - z) or sum (x + z), while the goal states it as an expanded sum/difference such as ... - Y 2 + Y 3.
applicability.use_when: the rewrite you need is syntactic (a `rw`/definitional match) and does not fire on the goal's stated form, but the form it needs differs from the goal only by a ring/abel identity; restate the whole goal via `suffices` with the subterm bracketed, prove the restated goal, and close the residual with `convert … using 2; abel`.
applicability.avoid_when: the restated form is not actually reachable by the intended rewrites (the `suffices` goal must still close); the residual is not a ring identity that `convert`/`abel` can discharge; or the original form already matches the rewrite, in which case the `suffices` is redundant and a plain `rw`/`have` suffices (compare `sum_of_rdist_eq_step_condRuzsaDist`, lines 113-115).

claims.claim: The restated suffices goal closes by `symm` (line 126), then a four-lemma `rw` chain of `condMutualInfo_of_inj_map` and `condMutualInfo_comm` (lines 136-139), then `congr! 3 with ω` with the pointwise subgoals closed by `simp` and `rw [sub_sub, add_sub_left_comm, ← sub_sub]; simp` (lines 140-143), and the two injectivity side goals closed by `(Prod.ext_iff.1 h).2` and `(Prod.ext_iff.1 h).1` (lines 144-145).
claims.evidence: https://github.com/teorth/pfr/blob/1ef23c3c5a83db690fe3b3b5c2e8299fae17b81a/PFR/Fibring.lean#L126-L145; the file is built by the project's CI, .github/workflows/push.yml running leanprover/lean-action@v1.2.0 (lake build) on push to master and pull_request

claims.claim: The residual difference between the bracketed conditioning `Y 0 - Y 1 - (Y 2 - Y 3)` and the original `Y 0 - Y 1 - Y 2 + Y 3` is discharged in one line by `convert this using 2; abel` (line 125).
The `suffices` isolates a one-line discharge (line 125) from a 20-line proof of the restated goal (lines 126-145).
claims.evidence: line spans in the copied file PFR/Fibring.lean: discharge = L125 (1 line), restated-goal proof = L126-L145 (20 lines)

claims.claim: The same suffices-to-a-reformulated-form-then-ring-discharge move appears elsewhere in the repository: Endgame.lean line 389 has `suffices sum4 = sum1 + p.η * (sum2 + sum3) by linarith`, restating the goal into an equivalent arithmetic form and discharging the residual with `linarith`.

metrics.how_counted: line spans in PFR/Fibring.lean: discharge = line 125 (`convert this using 2; abel`), restated-goal proof = lines 126-145

consequences: Creates two obligations: (1) the restated `suffices` goal, which must be reachable by the rewrites that motivated the restatement; (2) the residual, that the restated form implies the original — here a ring identity discharged by `convert this using 2; abel`. A `suffices` whose restated form is not actually matched by the intended lemma fails only when the restated goal is attacked; the residual can silently become a stuck ring goal if the two forms are not genuinely equal. The injectivity rewrites also leave side goals (that each map is injective per fixed conditioning), closed here by `(Prod.ext_iff.1 h).2` and `(Prod.ext_iff.1 h).1`.
